meta.title: SCIM 2.0 (HRMS Sync): inactive while FF-005 is not enabled
gaps: Set or verify the undefined FF-005 tenant feature flag as disabled and then enabled
Trigger user creation, update, and deprovisioning events in an external HRMS system
Observe that no SCIM sync activity occurs for the disabled-flag trigger
Observe and verify normal SCIM synchronization after enabling FF-005
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Set or verify the undefined FF-005 tenant feature flag as disabled and then enabled; Trigger user creation, update, and deprovisioning events in an external HRMS system; Observe that no SCIM sync activity occurs for the disabled-flag trigger; Observe and verify normal SCIM synchronization after enabling FF-005

args.need: disable and then enable FF-005, trigger the HRMS SCIM integration for user changes in each state, and verify that the first trigger produces no sync while the second produces a normal sync

steps.note: The required feature-flag control, external HRMS trigger, and SCIM activity oracle are not available in the catalog.
Provides the required final assertion that the available browser screen has no visible crash or server error, but it does not verify SCIM behavior.
